item.title: The USPS Tells Contractors No More Immigrant CDL Drivers. Here’s How We Got Here.
item.description: USPS didn't track deaths. It didn't verify who was authorized to transport its freight. And it kept hiring carriers with conditional safety ratings while 79 people died in contractor crashes over three years. Now, with Duffy's DOT threatening to revoke California's CDL program and USPS's first enforcement attempt collapsing within days, the Postal Service is trying again, this time claiming safety as its priority, a priority it ignored for a decade.
